messages:
sasha: Heads up — Senior ML candidate Kiran Patel scheduled Thurs 11:00am PT. Zoom link booked (see below). Need: panel confirm, scribe for notes, debrief owner to submit final rec in 24h. Anyone able to own scribe?

lia: I can scribe and take the debrief.

miguel: I'll join panel. Can cover model eval + takehome discussion. Also suggest adding a short prompt evaluation to rubric.

recruiter-bot: Candidate Kiran Patel confirmed. Resume + takehome uploaded: https://recruiting.redwood.com/candidates/12345. Calendar invite sent.

people-ops: Quick reminder — use rubric v2.1 (new anchors). Weighting: Technical 50, Design 30, Communication 20. Debrief doc template: https://docs.redwood.com/interviews/debrief-template

sasha: Thanks @lia and @miguel. @people-ops is the rubric snippet below the latest? I'll paste anchors so everyone has the same frame.

sasha: ```Rubric v2.1 anchors
Technical (50): correctness, reproducibility, complexity tradeoffs (0-5)
Design (30): system-level thinking, scaling, failure modes (0-5)
Communication (20): clarity, feedback handling, synthesis (0-5)
Final recommendation: Hire / No Hire / Strong Hire
Note: please include specific examples and any failing test cases observed.```

lia: copying into debrief doc now. One ask — for takehome, what threshold for time cutoff? Did we set 3h soft limit?

people-ops: We generally expect 4h max; flag if >6h. For this role, 3-5h ok. Put estimated hours in the debrief.

miguel: cool. @sasha can you drop the Zoom + interview room name? I'll prep 2-3 bullet questions for model eval.

sasha: Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/987654321  room: "ML-Interviews-1" I'll add the 3 bullets to the calendar.

karen: Quick logistics — please CC hiring-manager on debrief. Also, if candidate requests a remote accommodation, escalate to people-ops.

sasha: Got it. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
